court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: Principal Family Court, Chennai, HMOP.No.3914 of 2024
facts_of_case: The respondent filed an application for divorce under Section 13(1) (ia) of Hindu Marriage Act. The petition sought dissolution of marriage on the ground of desertion, but the pleadings mentioned cruelty. An amendment application was filed to add 'cruelty' in the prayer portion.

legal_principles.principle: A clarificatory amendment need not be rejected on the ground of delay in filing the petition.
legal_principles.held: It is only clarificatory in nature and the same need not be rejected on the ground of delay in filing the petition.

legal_principles.principle: The substance of the averment found in the original petition and the section mentioned in the preamble portion are relevant.
legal_principles.held: Having regard to the substance of the averment found in the original petition and also the Section mentioned in the preamble portion, this Court feels that it is necessary

outcome.final_order: The Civil Revision Petition is partly allowed and the order passed by the Principal Family Court, Chennai, is set aside.

use_for_drafting: petitioner's challenge to family court order
